posts.zh:
dsh-wsl-expose 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。从 WSL2 走 IPv6/IPv4 经反向代理（Lucky）把 DSH Web GUI 暴露到公网：/wan up 一键建立 socat 中继、Windows portproxy、防火墙与 trusted-host 白名单；域名与端口可在设置卡片或命令中配置。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7b3b59b64e5201556d50.html
posts.en:
dsh-wsl-expose is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and trusted-host fence, with a Settings card plus commands to configure the domain and ports.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-7b3b59b64e5201556d50.html
